task.title: Modifying the disentitlement — Claim in MPS

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the out of Canada issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 2.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim with the disentitlement that must be rescinded.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “[Disentitlement information and dates] — rescind.”
Remarks line 2: If required, type other information or changes (including claimant’s reports, if necessary).
Remarks line 4: Type your name and telephone number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the appropriate letter (D-01-00-00, N-00-00-00 or D-60-00-00). Refer to Out of Canada and select the task related to the appropriate BT for the attributes to include. Also select the following attributes:

ul.li:
This letter replaces or Footnote (2365): Select the appropriate option:
For any BT other than CCB or family caregiver benefits, select only This letter replaces the one sent to you on .
For CCB or family caregiver benefits, select both This letter replaces the one sent to you on and Footnote .
Footnote: Type “We are unable to pay you [compassionate care benefits or family caregiver benefits] from [date] because you have not proven that you [are or were] providing care or support to your family member while you [are or were] out of Canada.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI for the out of Canada issue.
